The Wellegacy Way

Restoration is not
a reward. It's a
right.

Wellegacy exists for women who've spent enough years taking care of everything and everyone else. This is travel designed with your whole self in mind — not your schedule, your to-do list, or your miles balance. Every itinerary we build is a direct investment in the life you're building, the woman you already are, and the peace you deserve to inhabit fully.

The Method

We handle
everything.
You just show up.

From the first application to the last transfer, every detail is chosen with your restoration as the non-negotiable. Zero chasing. Zero logistics. All presence.

01

Apply & Connect

Submit a short application so we can understand your goals, budget, and travel timeline. Within 48 hours, you'll receive a link to book your complimentary consultation with LaTanya.

02

We Build Your Journey

Your dedicated travel curator designs a custom itinerary — hotels, transfers, experiences, and every detail — built specifically around your life and your goals. Expect clear communication throughout.

03

Travel With Assurance

Show up. Everything else has been handled. You move through your experience knowing every detail was chosen with your restoration as the non-negotiable.

The Founder
"I didn't discover the importance of restoration — I lived the cost of ignoring it."

LaTanya is a M.A. HWC-designated wellness travel curator, ASTA-affiliated agent, and former DAU-Certified Contracting Officer with a background in multimillion-dollar contract management. She built Wellegacy because she needed it — and because thousands of women just like her needed it too. Her eye for precision. Her commitment to care. Your entire journey, handled.
